nodes.name: CartController.java
nodes.summary: Exposes authenticated user cart REST endpoints for reading a cart, adding items, updating quantities, removing items, and clearing the cart. It delegates cart behavior to CartService and uses the authenticated UserPrincipal id for user scoping.

nodes.name: CartItemRequest.java
nodes.summary: Defines the request payload for adding an item to a cart, carrying product id and quantity fields. Bean validation enforces a positive product id and a quantity of at least one.

nodes.name: CartQuantityRequest.java
nodes.summary: Defines the request payload for changing the quantity of an existing cart item. It uses Bean Validation to require a non-negative quantity so zero can represent removal.

nodes.name: CartItemResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the serialized representation of a cart item and maps CartItem entities to response records. The mapper includes a summarized product payload and item quantity.

nodes.name: CartResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the serialized cart response and calculates a cart total from product variant prices and discounts. It safely handles null carts or item lists while mapping items through CartItemResponse.

nodes.name: Cart.java
nodes.summary: Models the shopping cart entity with a one-to-one user relationship and a cascading collection of cart items. The entity is persisted to the carts table and owns item lifecycle through orphan removal.

nodes.name: CartItem.java
nodes.summary: Models an item in a shopping cart with cart, product variant, and quantity relationships. It enforces a positive quantity and provides a helper for incrementing existing quantities.
nodes.languageNotes: The unique constraint is declared on cart_id and product_id while the entity field maps productVariant to the product_id join column.

nodes.name: CartItemRepository.java
nodes.summary: Defines Spring Data access methods for cart items by cart id, product id, and product variant id. It supports querying and cleanup operations around cart item persistence.

nodes.name: CartRepository.java
nodes.summary: Defines cart persistence access by user id, including a pessimistic write-lock query for transactional cart mutation. It backs the cart service's read and write workflows.
nodes.languageNotes: The repository uses @Lock(PESSIMISTIC_WRITE) with a fetch join to guard cart item mutations during concurrent operations.

nodes.name: CartService.java
nodes.summary: Declares the cart service contract for reading, adding, updating, removing, and clearing user cart contents. Controllers and implementations use this interface as the cart workflow boundary.

nodes.name: CartServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements transactional cart workflows with user and cart row locking, cache eviction, product lookup, and cart response mapping. It creates carts on demand, mutates item quantities, removes items, and clears carts after user-scoped validation.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring cache annotations are paired with transactional methods so cart reads can be cached while all mutations evict cached cart entries.

nodes.name: CartController
nodes.summary: REST controller coordinating user cart HTTP requests with CartService operations. It exposes five cart endpoints under the user API surface.

nodes.name: CartItemRequest
nodes.summary: Request record carrying product id and quantity when adding a cart item. Validation annotations constrain both fields before service logic runs.

nodes.name: CartQuantityRequest
nodes.summary: Request record carrying a replacement cart item quantity. Its minimum value allows zero for removal-oriented quantity updates.

nodes.name: CartItemResponse
nodes.summary: Response record for one cart line item. It exposes item id, summarized product data, and quantity for API clients.

nodes.name: CartResponse
nodes.summary: Response record for a user's full cart, including item responses and computed total price. It implements Serializable for cache-friendly response storage.

nodes.name: Cart
nodes.summary: JPA cart aggregate root tied to exactly one user and many cart items. Cascade and orphan removal make the cart responsible for item persistence lifecycle.

nodes.name: CartItem
nodes.summary: JPA cart item entity that joins a cart to a product variant with a validated quantity. It provides a quantity increment helper for merging duplicate cart additions.

nodes.name: CartItemRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository interface for CartItem queries and deletes. Method names derive lookup behavior from cart and product identifiers.

nodes.name: CartRepository
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository interface for Cart lookup by user id. It includes a pessimistic-lock variant that fetches item collections for safe writes.

nodes.name: CartService
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the cart use cases exposed to controllers. It returns CartResponse for reads and uses void commands for mutations.

nodes.name: CartServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Concrete CartService implementation that coordinates repositories, transactions, locking, and cache invalidation. It centralizes cart mutation rules for authenticated users.

nodes.name: getCartByUserId
nodes.summary: Handles the current user's cart retrieval and returns the service response with HTTP 200. The user id is read from the authenticated principal.

nodes.name: addItemToCart
nodes.summary: Handles cart item creation from a validated request payload. It delegates item insertion to the service and returns HTTP 201 on success.

nodes.name: updateQuantity
nodes.summary: Handles quantity replacement for a product already in the authenticated user's cart. It delegates the update and returns an empty HTTP 200 response.

nodes.name: removeItemFromCart
nodes.summary: Handles deletion of a product from the authenticated user's cart. It delegates removal to the cart service and returns HTTP 204.

nodes.name: clearCart
nodes.summary: Handles clearing all items from the authenticated user's cart. It delegates to CartService and returns HTTP 204 after mutation.

nodes.name: fromEntity
nodes.summary: Maps a CartItem entity into a cart item response record. It returns null for null input and delegates product shaping to ProductResponse.summaryFromEntity.

nodes.name: fromEntity
nodes.summary: Maps a Cart entity into a full cart response and computes the total price from variant prices or discount prices. It also converts cart items into nested CartItemResponse records.

nodes.name: incrementQuantity
nodes.summary: Adds the provided amount to the existing cart item quantity. The helper is used when an added product is already present in the cart.

nodes.name: getCartByUserId
nodes.summary: Loads a user's cart, raises ResourceNotFoundException when absent, and maps it to CartResponse. The read-only transactional method is cacheable by user id.

nodes.name: addItemToCart
nodes.summary: Locks the user and cart, creates a cart if needed, validates the product, and either increments an existing cart item or appends a new one. It saves the cart and evicts cart cache entries after mutation.

nodes.name: updateQuantity
nodes.summary: Locks the user cart, locates the requested item, and either removes it for non-positive quantities or updates its quantity. The method persists the cart and evicts cached cart data.

nodes.name: removeItemFromCart
nodes.summary: Locks and loads the user cart, finds the matching product item, removes it, and saves the cart. Missing users, carts, or products are reported through ResourceNotFoundException.

nodes.name: clearCart
nodes.summary: Locks the user cart, clears all cart items, and saves the aggregate. Cache eviction keeps future cart reads from returning stale contents.
